story.fullStory:
Post Malone's "I Had Some Help" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Had Some Help" is a song by American musician Post Malone featuring American country music singer Morgan Wallen.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 67 weeks on the chart.

I Had Some Help was released in 2024.
